_comment: Declarations in this repo that shadow a webindex export, with why they have not been adopted. A ratchet: entries may leave, never arrive. Anything not listed fails verify-engine-usage, so the next fork is an argued decision rather than a quiet copy. An entry that no longer matches anything also fails, so the list cannot rot.

forks.src/config.ts:envInt: NOT a duplicate, despite the name: this one reads a RAW environment variable, the engine’s resolves a suffix through the brand prefix (ULTRADOC_*). Same signature, different input. Renaming it would be clearer than adopting it.
forks.src/sources/fetch.ts:HttpResult: fetch stack genuinely diverges from the engine's — conditional GET / streaming caps / consent stripping. Reconciling it is a behaviour decision, not a dedup.

forks.src/clone.ts:sameCommit: the engine’s is strict equality; this one treats an ABBREVIATION as a match. A dossier records the commit it was built against and git abbreviates SHAs almost everywhere, so strict equality answers “different” to a full SHA against its own prefix — and every stored citation silently stops being re-validated. Caught by tests/check.test.ts the moment the engine’s was swapped in.
